label: bi-directional XDCR with App Services
type: active-active (bi-directional) XDCR between clusters that also run App Services / Sync Gateway, enabled by the `mobile=Active` replication option. Requires Couchbase Server 7.6.6+, App Services 4.0+, and the target bucket's `enableCrossClusterVersioning` property; using it with App Services older than 4.0 can corrupt data.
evidence: Create or update a XDCR replication with `mobile=Active` option from the UI, starting from Server 7.6.6 version onwards.
The pre-requisite to use `mobile=Active` is to set the bucket property `enableCrossClusterVersioning`.
Bi-directional XDCR with App Services versions earlier than 4.0 can cause data corruption. Only use bi-directional replication with App Services 4.0+.
Couchbase Server 7.6.6 and App Services 4.0+ support bi-directional (active-active) XDCR replications between clusters that have App Services enabled.
note: A three-product version constraint (Server, App Services, bucket property) with a data-corruption consequence, assembled from a Server procedure page and two Capella pages - no single page states all three legs. This is the round's strongest cross-product finding and the reason it is promoted at 3 files rather than left as a note: the corruption warning appears on the Capella side and the enabling option on the Server side.
